answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake tied to a single verifiable work history before it can trade: crossing a canyon on one narrow bridge, every identity pays in time and capital. An onyx ledger binds one reputation to one verified keypair, and every deal carries a cipher proof linking it to that history. A sybil attacker must therefore fund and age thousands of separate bonded identities, so forging scale costs linearly per fake while an honest agent pays only once.
